shapes.name: Maximum Limit
shapes.description: Constraint of the form "maximum X is N" / "at most N" / "no more than N". Body atoms fire when the measured value EXCEEDS the limit (violation-inverted pattern) using a swrlb:greaterThan Builtin atom against a Literal threshold. Rule_Id format: R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<LIMIT>_V.
shapes.cypher_template:
MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET C_Main.label = '<CLASS_NAME>'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:decimal'

MERGE (B_Gt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:greaterThan', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET B_Gt.label = 'greaterThan'

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET DP_V.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', DP_V.range = 'xsd:boolean'

MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<LIMIT>_V', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET r.SWRL = '<SWRL_EXPRESSION>', r.kind = 'violation'

MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?<ENTITY_VAR>', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (vValue:Var {name: '?<VALUE_VAR>', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (litX:Literal {lex: '<LIMIT>', datatype: 'xsd:decimal', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (litT:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (a1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<LIMIT>_V_A1', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET a1.type = 'ClassAtom', a1.iri = 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', a1.SWRL_label = '<CLASS_NAME>'

MERGE (a2:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<LIMIT>_V_A2', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET a2.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2.iri = 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>'

MERGE (a3:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<LIMIT>_V_A3', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET a3.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3.iri = 'swrlb:greaterThan', a3.SWRL_label = 'greaterThan'

MERGE (h1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<LIMIT>_V_H1', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET h1.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1.iri = 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', h1.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>'

MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {order: 1}]->(a1)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {order: 2}]->(a2)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {order: 3}]->(a3)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_HEAD {order: 1}]->(h1)

MERGE (a1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Gt)
MERGE (h1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_V)

MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {pos: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {pos: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {pos: 2}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {pos: 1}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {pos: 2}]->(litX)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {pos: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {pos: 2}]->(litT);

shapes.name: Range (Between Min and Max)
shapes.description: Constraint of the form "between MIN and MAX". PRESERVES the existing cypher_template.txt convention: emit TWO SEPARATE violation Rules -- one min-rule (reusing the min_limit shape's swrlb:lessThan pattern) and one max-rule (reusing the max_limit shape's swrlb:greaterThan pattern) -- never a single combined Rule. Both rules share the same Class/DatatypeProperty (MERGE-reused, same iri) but each gets its own violation DatatypeProperty, Var set, and Atom subgraph. No new schema shape is introduced; this entry documents the min-rule + max-rule PAIR together as one worked example.
shapes.swrl_pattern:
MIN rule: <CLASS_NAME>(?e) ^ <PROPERTY_NAME>(?e, ?val) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?val, "<MIN>"^^xsd:decimal) -> <VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MIN>(?e, true)
MAX rule: <CLASS_NAME>(?e) ^ <PROPERTY_NAME>(?e, ?val) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?val, "<MAX>"^^xsd:decimal) -> <VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MAX>(?e, true)

shapes.name: Existence / Count Requirement
shapes.description: Constraint requiring at least N instances of a related quantity (modeled as a count-valued DatatypeProperty, e.g. a pre-computed count on the parent entity) to exist. New territory (D-12): modeled as a swrlb: Builtin ATOM PAIR against a Literal threshold -- one Builtin atom establishes the count value is a valid non-negative existence check (swrlb:greaterThanOrEqual against 0), the second Builtin atom checks the count against the required minimum (swrlb:lessThan -> violation-inverted). Reuses ONLY the documented node labels (Class, DatatypeProperty, ObjectProperty, Rule, Atom, Var, Literal, Builtin) and relationships (HAS_BODY, HAS_HEAD, REFERS_TO, ARG) -- no new schema surface. CRITICAL (Pitfall 1): the Var MERGE for the count variable keys on BOTH name and project -- omitting project reintroduces the historical cross-project Var collision bug. Rule_Id format: R_<DOMAIN>_<COUNT_PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V.
shapes.cypher_template:
MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET C_Main.label = '<CLASS_NAME>'

MERGE (DP_Count:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<COUNT_PROPERTY>', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET DP_Count.SWRL_label = '<COUNT_PROPERTY>', DP_Count.range = 'xsd:integer'

MERGE (B_Gte:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:greaterThanOrEqual', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET B_Gte.label = 'greaterThanOrEqual'

MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan'

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET DP_V.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', DP_V.range = 'xsd:boolean'

MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<COUNT_PROPERTY>_MIN_<MIN_REQUIRED>_V', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET r.SWRL = '<SWRL_EXPRESSION>', r.kind = 'violation'

MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?<ENTITY_VAR>', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:Building', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET C_Main.label = 'Building'

MERGE (DP_Count:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:stairwellCount', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET DP_Count.SWRL_label = 'stairwellCount', DP_Count.range = 'xsd:integer'

MERGE (B_Gte:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:greaterThanOrEqual', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET B_Gte.label = 'greaterThanOrEqual'

MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan'

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:stairwellCountBelowMin', project: $project, graph: 'OntoGraph'})
SET DP_V.SWRL_label = 'stairwellCountBelowMin', DP_V.range = 'xsd:boolean'

MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_STR_STAIRWELLCOUNT_MIN_2_V', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET r.SWRL = 'Building(?b) ^ stairwellCount(?b, ?count) ^ swrlb:greaterThanOrEqual(?count, "0"^^xsd:integer) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?count, "2"^^xsd:integer) -> stairwellCountBelowMin(?b, true)', r.kind = 'violation'

MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?b', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
MERGE (vCount:Var {name: '?count', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (litZero:Literal {lex: '0', datatype: 'xsd:integer', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
MERGE (litMin:Literal {lex: '2', datatype: 'xsd:integer', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
MERGE (litT:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})

MERGE (a1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_STR_STAIRWELLCOUNT_MIN_2_V_A1', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET a1.type = 'ClassAtom', a1.iri = 'ex:Building', a1.SWRL_label = 'Building'

MERGE (a4:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_STR_STAIRWELLCOUNT_MIN_2_V_A4', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET a4.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a4.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a4.SWRL_label = 'lessThan'
MERGE (h1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_STR_STAIRWELLCOUNT_MIN_2_V_H1', project: $project, graph: 'Metagraph'})
SET h1.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1.iri = 'ex:stairwellCountBelowMin', h1.SWRL_label = 'stairwellCountBelowMin'
